system.description:
Requirements: You must be utilizing Frost Dragon Style

Cost: 1 Focus

You strike at the precise right moment to foil your opponent.

Once per turn, when a creature enters the range of your equipped weapon, or performs an Action while within range of your equipped weapon, you may spend -1 Focus before the attack is rolled to declare your use of this ability as a Reaction that resolves first.

Make an Attack against that opponent with your equipped weapon. If your attack deals Damage, their Action is canceled and wasted, or their Move is halted, depending on which triggered this ability.
